prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore with workspace-scoped 404 authorization and contiguous renumbering, added toast action support and an Undo button on the post-delete toast on the Episodes page in both English and Korean, updated CHANGELOG.md, and added restore tests.

+

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Pilot", episode_order=1, story_summary="Opening act"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": episode_order,
+            "story_summary": story_summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, **kwargs):
+    payload = {
+        "episode_id": episode_id,
+        "cut_order": cut_order,
+        "script": kwargs.get("script", f"Scene {cut_order}"),
+        "selected_layout": kwargs.get("selected_layout", "single"),
+        "aspect_ratio": kwargs.get("aspect_ratio", "1:1"),
+        "dialogues": kwargs.get("dialogues", []),
+        "appearing_characters": kwargs.get("appearing_characters", []),
+        "refer_prev_cut": kwargs.get("refer_prev_cut", True),
+        "image_path": kwargs.get("image_path"),
+    }
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json=payload)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+
+    patch_fields = {}
+    if "appearing_characters" in kwargs:
+        patch_fields["appearing_characters"] = kwargs["appearing_characters"]
+    if "refer_prev_cut" in kwargs:
+        patch_fields["refer_prev_cut"] = kwargs["refer_prev_cut"]
+    if patch_fields:
+        u = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}", headers=headers, json=patch_fields)
+        assert u.status_code == 200, u.text
+        cut = u.json()
+    return cut
+

+def test_duplicate_episode_changes_and_deletions_are_isolated(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Take One", episode_order=1, story_summary="Original summary")
+    orig_cut1 = _create_cut(

+        h,
+        ep["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Original script 1",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "A", "text": "Hello"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"name": "A"}],
+        image_path="https://cdn.example.com/1.png",
+    )
+    orig_cut2 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Original script 2",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "B", "text": "World"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"name": "B"}],
+        image_path="https://cdn.example.com/2.png",
+    )
+
+    dup = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts) == 2
+
+    # Edit the copy and one of its cuts, and delete its second cut
+    r = client.put(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup['id']}",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Alternate Take", "story_summary": "Changed summary"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    r = client.put(
+        f"/api/v1/cuts/{dup_cuts[0]['id']}",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "script": "Rewritten script",
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "A", "text": "Goodbye"}],
+            "appearing_characters": [{"name": "Z"}],
+            "image_path": "https://cdn.example.com/changed.png",
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    r = client.delete(f"/api/v1/cuts/{dup_cuts[1]['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 204
+
+    # Original episode and cuts remain completely untouched
+    orig_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert orig_after["title"] == "Take One"
+    assert orig_after["story_summary"] == "Original summary"
+
+    orig_cuts_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(orig_cuts_after) == 2
+    assert orig_cuts_after[0]["script"] == orig_cut1["script"]
+    assert orig_cuts_after[0]["dialogues"] == orig_cut1["dialogues"]
+    assert orig_cuts_after[0]["appearing_characters"] == orig_cut1["appearing_characters"]
+    assert orig_cuts_after[0]["image_path"] == orig_cut1["image_path"]
+    assert orig_cuts_after[1]["id"] == orig_cut2["id"]
+
+    # Deleting the original episode closes the gap and does not affect the copy or its cuts
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 404
+
+    dup_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert dup_after.status_code == 200
+    assert dup_after.json()["title"] == "Alternate Take"
+    assert dup_after.json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    dup_cuts_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts_after) == 1
+    assert dup_cuts_after[0]["script"] == "Rewritten script"
+
+    # Duplicating the surviving episode and deleting the new copy leaves the source intact
+    dup2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup2["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    surviving = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert surviving.status_code == 200
+    assert surviving.json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    assert len(client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()) == 1
+

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Pilot", episode_order=1, story_summary="Summary"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": episode_order,
+            "story_summary": story_summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, **kwargs):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": kwargs.get("script", f"Scene {cut_order}"),
+            "selected_layout": kwargs.get("selected_layout", "single"),
+            "aspect_ratio": kwargs.get("aspect_ratio", "1:1"),
+            "dialogues": kwargs.get("dialogues", []),
+            "image_path": kwargs.get("image_path"),
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    if "appearing_characters" in kwargs:
+        u = client.put(
+            f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}",
+            headers=headers,
+            json={"appearing_characters": kwargs["appearing_characters"]},
+        )
+        assert u.status_code == 200, u.text
+        cut = u.json()
+    return cut
+

+def test_restore_deleted_episode_returns_at_previous_place_with_cuts(client):

+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", episode_order=1, story_summary="First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", episode_order=2, story_summary="Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", episode_order=3, story_summary="Third")
+
+    img_path = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="ep2-cut1")
+    cut1 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Establishing shot",
+        selected_layout="wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Wait!"}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"name": "Mina"}],
+        image_path=img_path,
+    )
+    cut2 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Reaction shot",
+        image_path="https://cdn.example.com/ep2-cut2.png",
+    )
+
+    # Delete episode 2; ep3 moves up to 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed_after_delete = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()

+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_after_delete] == [1, 2]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json() == []
+
+    # Restore episode 2; it returns at place 2 and ep3 shifts down to 3
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)

+    listed_after_restore = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()

+    # Delete first episode and restore it at position 1

+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Delete last (3) then middle (2), then restore ep3 -> clamps to 2 with no gap
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
